name: Journey to the Marsh
label: Quest
description: Your class sends you to Dustwallow Marsh to speak with Tabetha. Her knowledge is the first step toward earning your wand.
intro: Your class sends you to Dustwallow Marsh to speak with Tabetha. Her knowledge is the first step toward earning your wand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now it is time for you to earn your mage's wand. To begin this quest, speak with the human hermit Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh. You will find her shack deep in the marsh, west of Theramore.
Speak with her, for her knowledge is vast. You will find Tabetha's cottage west of Theramore, and just north of the Stonemaul Ruins.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Quiet! I'm in a delicate juncture and mustn't be disturbed!

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
